response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, open-source contributions, and exposure to distributed systems and performance-critical code, but lacks explicit evidence of building enterprise-scale experimentation or growth platforms, feature-flagging systems, or AI-driven measurement frameworks required for the role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across languages including TypeScript, Python-adjacent DLang, and C/C++
Proven track record in building scalable, distributed systems (e.g., high-throughput data services at Dunnhumby)
Active open-source contributor with tools for testing, telemetry, and GIS data systems demonstrating systems thinking
concerns: No clear evidence of designing or shipping experimentation platforms, feature flagging, or growth measurement systems
Limited mention of statistical analysis, guardrails, bias detection, or AI-augmented decision systems in growth context
Experience with AI tools is tangential (MCP agents) and not tied to experimentation or scalable measurement infrastructure
